correctness.rationale: Rechecked the even-only repair from basis multiplication, including n=2. The left identity amounts to reversal and translation by two, fixing exactly the parity-constant sequences. In the middle identity the coefficient of t^(2j) in P(t²) is s_j=a_j+a_(j+m), and translation by two acts transitively there. In the right identity the same constancy is necessary, but P(t²)=P(t⁴) is additionally required; multiplication by two permutes the even exponents if m is odd, while when m is even reduction modulo n preserves divisibility by four and the coefficient at exponent two forces s_j=0. The pair-sum map is onto in all characteristics, so these conditions give the dimensions. The commutation test implies period gcd(n,3) together with zero coefficients on odd indices; all period classes meet those indices. Intersecting with the parity-constant sequences yields pair sums c₀+c₁ for odd m and 2c₀ or 2c₁ for even m, giving exactly the stated characteristic switch. Reflections preserve each parity orbit, so each parity sum right-multiplies by e_j to itself and the stated product follows. In n=2 the full nucleus equals A although C=0, consistent with the left-zero basis multiplication. The proof uses no division by 2 or by the order. The supplied modular verifier was inspected, not executed, and the finite range is not used to justify arbitrary fields.
residual_risks: The repaired theorem is even-order only and uses the specified right-argument quandle convention; reversing the product changes nucleus labels.

value.rationale: Even-order dihedral algebras are the canonical non-Latin branch of the family. Their three failure-of-associativity kernels can be sizable while their common intersection vanishes, and in the same orders a change of coefficient characteristic restores a two-dimensional zero-product nucleus. The coefficient classification, explicit multiplication and separation of nucleus from commutant make the exact even-order result useful without any mathematical contribution from the prior odd row.
residual_risks: No assertion about automorphisms, ideals, or a classification beyond the dihedral family.
